overall: Board violated the OML by not responding within 10 days to executive session minutes requests and by not providing already-released minutes; no violation on the fee-schedule document. Compliance ordered only.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to respond within 10 days to two requests (March 30 and July 11, 2011) for executive session minutes on police union negotiating strategy.
allegations.key_passage: In both instances, the Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to Mr. Heydecker's request within 10 days of a request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to release police-contract executive session minutes already approved for release (April 5, 2011) when he re-requested them on July 11, 2011.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board should have provided Mr. Heydecker with the requested minutes at the time of his second request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide within 10 days a 'schedule of fee changes' document said to have been used at the March 29, 2011 open session.
allegations.key_passage: We therefore find that the Board did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide this document within 10 days of the complainant's request.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to respond within 10 days to his December 9, 2011 request for all executive session minutes from May 2010 through December 2011.
allegations.key_passage: The Board violated the Open Meeting Law by failing to respond to Mr. Heydecker's request within 10 days.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board failed to provide already-released executive session minutes within 10 days of his December 9, 2011 request.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, the Board should have provided Mr. Heydecker with the released executive session minutes within 10 days of his request.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law (no additional remedial action, since the Board had already provided all sought minutes).
remedy_passage: We order immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law, and caution that future similar violations may be considered evidence of intent to violate the law.
